title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (20/20): Letting Go at the Cliff's Edge
note_en: At the start of a sentence, 原来 signals a sudden realization of something that was true all along: 原来，他本来就是那块无缘补天的石头 "So he had been that stone all along." It's close to English "so it turns out..." or "so that's why..." Don't confuse it with 本来, which simply means "originally"; here the two even appear together.
